title: Consciousness proper combines subjectivity and the modern mind

statements.text: Homeostatic feelings are the basis of subjectivity, and consciousness proper results from combining that subjectivity with the exteroceptive, cognitive and linguistic processes of the modern mind. Human consciousness combines homeostatic feeling with exteroceptive images.

sources.locator: 5(a) interoceptive feelings support the continuity of conscious experience
sources.quote: Consciousness proper results from the combination of subjectivity with the exteroceptive, cognitive and linguistic processes that constitute the modern mind.
The consciousness of humans and of other complex organisms is the result of combining the process of homeostatic feeling with that of exteroceptive images.
